description: This file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes security token retrieval via curl, plugin client creation, and service state management.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and manage security tokens, including checking security configuration via curl.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Encapsulates a work function to be dispatched, with different inheritance based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for curl to write response data into a string.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is enabled by querying a local service.
